values.note: 30-amp RV sites $38 a night, 50-amp $44, pull-through $47, waterfront $52; electric tent sites $33. Extra tent on the same lot costs more. Monthly rates by phone; electricity may be charged on seasonal and monthly rentals. Deposits non-refundable. Boat launch fee is separate.

values.note: The campground page says 109 campsites; its FAQ and the city's park page say 105. Back-in sites except the pull-through class; grass and patio sites, waterfront sites on Muskegon Lake, electric tent sites. Specific sites are not guaranteed; assigned at check-in.

sites.source: https://muskegoncampground.com/campground/ ('features 109 campsites'; 50-amp and pull-through classes 'Can accommodate up to 45 foot RVs') + https://muskegoncampground.com/campground/frequently-asked-questions/ ('All campsites are back-in only, with the exception of a pull-through'; 'We have 105 campsites'; 'We can accommodate up to 45-foot RVs') + https://muskegon-mi.gov/parks/fishermans-landing-2/ ('Campsites (105)'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Five private shower stalls; coin washer/dryer. Dump station free to registered campers during office hours. Fish-cleaning station (fee), free campground boat dock, kayak launch; no swimming area. Gated (key or code).

facilities.source: https://muskegoncampground.com/campground/frequently-asked-questions/ ('bathhouse with 5 private shower stalls ... coin operated washer/dryer'; 'we do not offer Wi-Fi'; 'We do not have an onsite camp store'; dump station) + https://muskegoncampground.com/campground/, read 2026-10-22

values.note: Reserve by phone, (231) 726-6100; dates are guaranteed, specific sites are not. Next year's reservations open September 1. Changes to nights need 14 days' notice. Check-in 1 pm (no early check-in), check-out noon.

booking.source: https://muskegoncampground.com/campground/ ('call us directly at (231) 726-6100 to make your reservation') + https://muskegoncampground.com/campground/frequently-asked-questions/ ('Reservations for the following year start September 1st of the current year'; change/cancellation and check-in policies), read 2026-10-22

discounts.source: https://muskegoncampground.com/campground/frequently-asked-questions/ ('Do you have ... RV club membership discounts, or military discounts ...? We do not offer any type of discount program.'), read 2026-10-22

note: City of Muskegon-owned 18.6-acre waterfront park on the east end of Muskegon Lake, run by Fisherman's Landing & Campground, Inc.; the city's Ports and Parks project leases it to Mart Dock (lease set for March 15, 2026) and plans a port there, keeping the campground open through the 2026 season. Lakeshore Bike Trail at the gate, downtown nearby; Pere Marquette Beach 4 miles. Some seasonal/monthly campers but sells nightly stays. --Claude
